from collections import deque

def solve_C():
    n = int(input())
    a = list(map(int, input().split()))

    dq = deque()

    for A_i in a:
        size = 2 ** A_i
        dq.append(size)
        while len(dq) > 1 and dq[-1] == dq[-2]:
            last = dq.pop()
            dq.pop()
